# Tabler component references

This folder keeps only the Tabler files that are useful as Blade markup references.

- `preview/pages`: complete demo pages.
- `shared/includes`: reusable component, form, card, and layout snippets.
- `shared/layouts`: source layout examples.
- `docs/ui`: UI documentation markdown.

Browser-ready assets are not kept here. Use the public assets copied to:

- `public/assets/tabler/dist`
- `public/assets/tabler/static`
